"""Adversarial v2 UI envelope tests; v1 remains a separate exact codec."""

import copy
import importlib
import json
import sys
import types
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
PACKAGE = "mcad_general_authoring_store_tests"
package = types.ModuleType(PACKAGE)
package.__path__ = [str(ROOT / "blender_addon/mechanical_cad_blender")]
sys.modules[PACKAGE] = package
a = importlib.import_module(PACKAGE + ".general_authoring")
s = importlib.import_module(PACKAGE + ".general_authoring_store")
d = importlib.import_module(PACKAGE + ".general_sketch_draft")
v1 = importlib.import_module(PACKAGE + ".general_draft_store")
BASE = '{"schema_version":1,"id":"doc","name":"Part","units":"mm","parameters":{},"features":[],"active_feature":null}\n'


def authoring():
    command = d.GeneralSketchDraft(BASE)
    center, circle = command.execute(d.AddCircle(d.PointSeed(2, 3), 4.125)).entity_ids
    radius = command.execute(d.AddRelation("radius", (circle,), value="4 + 0.125")).constraint_id
    state = a.GeneralSketchAuthoringState(command)
    state.begin_circle(d.PointRef(center), 9)
    state.select((("circle", circle),))
    state.place_annotation(radius, (2, -3))
    return state


def test_v1_and_v2_reject_one_another_and_roundtrip_nested_command_exactly():
    state = authoring()
    command_payload = state.command_draft.checkpoint_payload()
    old = v1.dumps(state.command_draft)
    new = s.dumps(state)
    envelope = json.loads(new)
    assert envelope["schema_version"] == 2 and envelope["ui"]["schema_version"] == 1
    assert envelope["kind"] == "general_sketch_ui_draft"
    assert envelope["draft"] == command_payload == json.loads(old)["draft"]
    assert s.dumps(s.restore(new, BASE)) == new
    assert v1.dumps(state.command_draft) == old
    with pytest.raises(s.SnapshotError):
        s.loads(old)
    with pytest.raises(v1.SnapshotError):
        v1.loads(new)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "mutate",
    [
        lambda e: e.update(schema_version=1),
        lambda e: e.update(schema_version=3),
        lambda e: e.update(schema_version=True),
        lambda e: e.update(kind="rectangle_ui_draft"),
        lambda e: e.update(base_sha256="invented"),
        lambda e: e.update(pointer_capture=True),
        lambda e: e.pop("ui"),
        lambda e: e["ui"].update(schema_version=2),
        lambda e: e["ui"].update(schema_version=True),
        lambda e: e["ui"].update(revision=-1),
        lambda e: e["ui"].update(revision=True),
        lambda e: e["ui"].update(revision=2**53),
        lambda e: e["ui"].update(tool="Rectangle"),
        lambda e: e["ui"].update(queuedEnter=True),
        lambda e: e["ui"].update(input_lease={}),
        lambda e: e["ui"].update(gesture_grab=1),
        lambda e: e["ui"].update(process_token="process"),
        lambda e: e["ui"].update(solver_report={"ok": True}),
        lambda e: e["ui"]["selection"][0].update(id="invented"),
        lambda e: e["ui"]["selection"][0].update(kind="line"),
        lambda e: e["ui"]["selection"].append(e["ui"]["selection"][0]),
        lambda e: e["ui"].update(selection=[e["ui"]["selection"][0]] * 33),
        lambda e: e["ui"]["proposal"].update(kind="arc"),
        lambda e: e["ui"]["proposal"].update(pointer_capture=True),
        lambda e: e["ui"]["proposal"].update(radius=-1),
        lambda e: e["ui"]["proposal"].update(radius=True),
        lambda e: e["ui"]["proposal"].update(radius="4"),
        lambda e: e["ui"]["proposal"]["anchor"].update(point_id="invented"),
        lambda e: e["ui"]["proposal"]["anchor"].update(point_id=e["ui"]["selection"][0]["id"]),
        lambda e: e["ui"]["proposal"]["anchor"].update(position=[2, 3]),
        lambda e: e["ui"]["proposal"].update(anchor={"kind": "new", "position": [0, 1e6 + 1]}),
        lambda e: next(iter(e["ui"]["annotations"].values())).update(display="diameter"),
        lambda e: next(iter(e["ui"]["annotations"].values())).update(refs=["invented"]),
        lambda e: next(iter(e["ui"]["annotations"].values())).update(kind="distance"),
        lambda e: next(iter(e["ui"]["annotations"].values())).update(offset=[0, True]),
        lambda e: next(iter(e["ui"]["annotations"].values())).update(offset=[0, 0, 0]),
        lambda e: next(iter(e["ui"]["annotations"].values())).update(dragging=True),
        lambda e: e["ui"]["annotations"].update(
            invented=next(iter(e["ui"]["annotations"].values()))
        ),
        lambda e: e["ui"].update(annotations={f"r_d{i}": {} for i in range(513)}),
        lambda e: e["draft"].update(pointer_capture=True),
        lambda e: e["draft"]["journal"].update(schema_version=1),
        lambda e: e["draft"].update(next_id=1),
    ],
)
def test_unknown_versions_fields_and_forged_bindings_fail_without_changing_input(mutate):
    envelope = json.loads(s.dumps(authoring()))
    mutate(envelope)
    raw = json.dumps(envelope)
    before = raw
    with pytest.raises(s.SnapshotError):
        s.loads(raw)
    assert raw == before


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "raw",
    [
        None,
        {},
        [],
        "null",
        "[]",
        "{} junk",
        "{",
        "\ud800",
        '{"kind":"general_sketch_ui_draft","kind":"general_sketch_ui_draft"}',
        '{"schema_version":NaN}',
        '{"schema_version":Infinity}',
        '{"schema_version":-Infinity}',
        '{"schema_version":1e999}',
        "[" * 33 + "0" + "]" * 33,
        '{"schema_version":' + "9" * 129 + "}",
    ],
)
def test_strict_json_byte_boundary_rejects_nonfinite_deep_duplicate_and_malformed(raw):
    with pytest.raises(s.SnapshotError):
        s.loads(raw)


def test_nested_duplicate_keys_and_nonfinite_numbers_fail_publicly():
    raw = s.dumps(authoring())
    for mutated in [
        raw.replace('"tool":"Circle"', '"tool":"Circle","tool":"Circle"'),
        raw.replace('"radius":9', '"radius":NaN'),
        raw.replace('"radius":9', '"radius":1e999'),
    ]:
        assert mutated != raw
        with pytest.raises(s.SnapshotError):
            s.loads(mutated)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("place", ["raw_field", "base", "ui", "id"])
def test_escaped_lone_unicode_surrogates_are_rejected_before_restoration(place):
    state = authoring()
    constraint = next(iter(state.annotations))
    state.command_draft.begin_edit(constraint)
    state.command_draft.update_edit("invalid +( 🛠")
    envelope = json.loads(s.dumps(state))
    if place == "raw_field":
        envelope["draft"]["pending_edit"]["raw_text"] = "bad\ud800"
    elif place == "base":
        envelope["draft"]["document_json"] += "\ud800"
    elif place == "ui":
        envelope["ui"]["tool"] = "Select\udfff"
    else:
        envelope["ui"]["selection"][0]["id"] = "c_\ud800"
    raw = json.dumps(envelope, ensure_ascii=True)
    assert raw.encode("utf-8")  # Valid source bytes can decode to invalid strings.
    with pytest.raises(s.SnapshotError):
        s.loads(raw)
    assert s.dumps(state)


def test_exact_byte_budget_combines_both_payloads_and_counts_utf8(monkeypatch):
    state = authoring()
    state.command_draft.begin_edit(next(iter(state.annotations)))
    state.command_draft.update_edit("🛠" * 20)
    raw = s.dumps(state)
    size = len(raw.encode())
    assert size > len(raw)
    monkeypatch.setattr(s, "MAX_SNAPSHOT_BYTES", size)
    assert s.dumps(state) == raw and s.loads(raw)
    monkeypatch.setattr(s, "MAX_SNAPSHOT_BYTES", size - 1)
    before = state.ui_payload(), state.command_draft.checkpoint_payload()
    with pytest.raises(s.SnapshotError, match="byte limit"):
        s.dumps(state)
    with pytest.raises(s.SnapshotError, match="byte limit"):
        s.loads(raw)
    assert (state.ui_payload(), state.command_draft.checkpoint_payload()) == before
    monkeypatch.setattr(s, "MAX_SNAPSHOT_BYTES", 8 * 1024 * 1024)
    with pytest.raises(s.SnapshotError):
        s.loads(" " * (8 * 1024 * 1024) + raw)


def test_stale_base_is_exact_and_failed_text_is_retained():
    state = authoring()
    raw = s.dumps(state)
    for stale in (BASE + " ", BASE.rstrip(), BASE.replace('"Part"', '"Renamed"')):
        with pytest.raises(s.SnapshotError, match="different committed document"):
            s.restore(raw, stale)
        assert s.dumps(state) == raw
    assert s.restore(raw, BASE).document_json == BASE


def test_forged_relation_refs_to_another_real_circle_are_rejected():
    state = authoring()
    _, other = state.command_draft.execute(d.AddCircle(d.PointSeed(7, 8), 2)).entity_ids
    envelope = json.loads(s.dumps(state))
    next(iter(envelope["ui"]["annotations"].values()))["refs"] = [other]
    with pytest.raises(s.SnapshotError, match="relation provenance"):
        s.loads(json.dumps(envelope))


def test_old_exact_relation_signature_can_be_unavailable_after_changed_checkpoint():
    source = authoring().command_draft
    _, other = source.execute(d.AddCircle(d.PointSeed(7, 8), 2)).entity_ids
    base = json.dumps(source.candidate())
    edit = d.GeneralSketchDraft(base, source.feature_id, True)
    state = a.GeneralSketchAuthoringState(edit)
    driver = state.command_draft.sketch["constraints"][0]["id"]
    state.place_annotation(driver, (1, 2))
    # Represent a later bounded checkpoint where this relation changed refs.
    # Its exact original signature remains demonstrable from the unchanged base.
    payload = state.command_draft.checkpoint_payload()
    changed = copy.deepcopy(payload["accepted_sketch"])
    changed["constraints"][0]["refs"] = [other]
    payload["accepted_sketch"] = changed
    payload["journal"]["anchor"] = changed
    payload["journal"]["anchor_sequence"] = 1
    payload["revision"] = 1
    changed_draft = d.GeneralSketchDraft.from_checkpoint_payload(payload)
    changed_state = a.GeneralSketchAuthoringState(changed_draft, state.ui_payload())
    assert changed_state.status.annotations[0].state == "changed"
    assert s.restore(s.dumps(changed_state), base).status.annotations[0].state == "changed"
    assert changed_state.annotations == state.annotations
    with pytest.raises(d.DraftError, match="unavailable"):
        changed_state.move_annotation(driver, (2, 3))


def test_fresh_empty_ui_defaults_never_normalize_v1_command_source_types():
    old = authoring().command_draft
    document = old.candidate()
    document["features"][0]["sketch"]["circles"][0]["radius"] = 4
    base = json.dumps(document, indent=3) + "\n"
    old = d.GeneralSketchDraft(base, old.feature_id, True)
    old.begin_edit(old.sketch["constraints"][0]["id"])
    old.update_edit(" +bad 🛠 ")
    before = v1.dumps(old)
    state = a.GeneralSketchAuthoringState.from_v1_draft(v1.restore(before, base))
    restored = s.restore(s.dumps(state), base)
    assert v1.dumps(restored.command_draft) == before
    assert type(restored.command_draft.sketch["circles"][0]["radius"]) is int
    assert restored.ui_payload() == a.empty_ui()


def test_annotation_count_bound_is_atomic_for_live_placement(monkeypatch):
    state = authoring()
    _, circle = state.command_draft.execute(d.AddCircle(d.PointSeed(8, 9), 2)).entity_ids
    driver = state.command_draft.execute(d.AddRelation("radius", (circle,), value=2)).constraint_id
    before = s.dumps(state)
    monkeypatch.setattr(a, "MAX_ANNOTATIONS", 1)
    with pytest.raises(d.DraftError, match="Too many"):
        state.place_annotation(driver, (0, 1))
    assert s.dumps(state) == before


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "mutate",
    [
        lambda p: p.update(endpoint=[True, 2]),
        lambda p: p.update(endpoint=[0, 1e6 + 1]),
        lambda p: p.update(radius=2),
        lambda p: p.update(endpoint=[0]),
        lambda p: p.update(anchor={"kind": "new", "position": [0, 0], "point_id": "invented"}),
    ],
)
def test_malformed_line_proposals_fail_the_strict_codec(mutate):
    state = authoring()
    state.cancel_proposal()
    state.begin_line(d.PointSeed(0, 0), (1, 1))
    envelope = json.loads(s.dumps(state))
    mutate(envelope["ui"]["proposal"])
    with pytest.raises(s.SnapshotError):
        s.loads(json.dumps(envelope))


def test_legal_escaped_unicode_pairs_and_whitespace_raw_fields_stay_exact():
    state = authoring()
    state.command_draft.begin_edit(next(iter(state.annotations)))
    state.command_draft.update_edit(" 🛠 半径 + ( \t")
    escaped = json.dumps(json.loads(s.dumps(state)), ensure_ascii=True)
    restored = s.restore(escaped, BASE)
    assert restored.command_draft.pending_edit.raw_text == " 🛠 半径 + ( \t"
    assert s.dumps(restored) == s.dumps(state)
